Privacy and account data

Account and wallet records

12x12 stores account identifiers, login email, a password verifier, session information, wallet activity, and support tickets. Cashier records can include transaction IDs, network, wallet addresses and approval evidence.

How the service uses records

12x12 uses these records to sign you in, maintain the wallet ledger, process requests, and investigate transfer discrepancies. Session cookies keep you signed in. Blockchain transactions can be visible publicly.

Site analytics

12x12 uses a first-party cookie lasting up to 90 days to estimate unique browsers, count page views, and measure how many browsers were active in the last five minutes. Visitor analytics stores a random identifier in hashed form and is separate from account records. 12x12 also counts completed signups.

External services

The quote service requests market prices from external providers. The optional live chat uses HelpCrunch when opened.

Questions about your data

Use the site’s support tools for account questions. The operator’s legal identity, privacy contact, retention policy and applicable rights information have not been supplied for this release package.
